integrity: The proof independently derives the odd/even dihedral graph decompositions, gives explicit rank-two symmetric pattern matrices, classifies every two-white configuration, counts the minimum zero forcing sets, and uses \(M(G)\le Z(G)\) only to close equality.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard noncommuting graph of the dihedral group \(D_{2n}\) with \(n\ge3\).
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices.

General rank-at-most-two graph theory covers the bare minimum-rank conclusion once the graph decomposition is known; the new strengthened content is the exact minimum zero-forcing-set classification and polynomial.
The finite verifier is corroborative and does not replace the symbolic proof.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and real minimum rank of dihedral noncommuting graphs
